content:
[Intro]
[F5]

[Bridge]
[F5]

[Verse 1]
[F5]Engraved in dam-
nation Be-
neath the shadow of sub-
mergence
We await this
call to Armageddon
To arise in
legions of war

[Verse 2]
[G5]Burn the
holy words
and carve my
blasphemy angel bone
A faith buried
in fire
where a cold tomb
lies

[Verse 3]
[F5]This de-
sire in murdering the
slaves of Christ
Sound the horn to winter's
plague Storm
of one hundred years to
be forged by
tidal waves

[Bridge]
[F5]
Flesh bound by the
rites of demon lords

[Verse 4]
[F5]Diversity
in divine
Submerged in a
countless death of winter
Encryption of the
damned A haunting
curse to celebrate this
chaos

[Verse 5]
[D#5]
Whispers in rites of
blood
Metal and flesh are
joined for spell
Bathed in flames of the
serpent
Invoked on this
day of hell

[Bridge]
[F5]
Rising legion raised
for war
Confines of chains in
heaven's fall

[Verse 6]
[C5]
The
dead climb sky pre-
paring this in-
vasion
This in-
ferno of souls
rise from the cold lake of
hell

[Bridge]
[F#5]
[D#5]An embrace of suffering
[F#5]in transcendence
[D#5]In birth of the know-
[F#5]ledge of evil
[D#5]The black heart, in
[F#5]honor of the
[D#5]fallen Conquer all that
[F#5]deny
[D#5]My screams fill the time-
[F#5]less skies
[D#5]A torture harsh and
[F#5]beautiful
[D#5]Skinless souls placed
[F#5]as markers in
[D#5]possessive praise of hell's firstborn
[F#5]

[Verse 7]
[C5]
Obedience in
conjuration of
swallowed souls
Trapped in eternal
sleep below this
surface
Courting death at the
hands of fools,
lost in silence
A waken in spoken
words of the e-
voking art

[Verse 8]
[G5]Burn all re-
morse
upon your
cold pale flesh
Give to me your
blood
like a fucking
sacrament

[Verse 9]
[F5]Enigmatic
force of deception
This order of the
formless Born from
black decree
Pestilence, in the form of
storms To drown the
armies of the holy

[Outro]
[F5]
